summary_md: **Arnaud Mercier - #Entrepreneur #Versailles ([@arnaudmercier](https://x.com/arnaudmercier/status/2115711160624332994))** shares **Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents** ([arXiv 2610.37461](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.37461v1)), which enforces conversation protocols such as "get explicit confirmation before changing anything" with session types around an untrusted model rather than relying on prompts, with code at [miladsikaroudi/concordat](https://github.com/miladsikaroudi/concordat).

referenced_urls.title: Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents Enforcing conversation protocols on a model that cannot be trusted to follow them

relevance: Protocol enforcement outside the model is a robust harness-design pattern.

media.description: Figure from the paper: a code listing alongside the protocol state diagram Concordat enforces.
